DO WE WANT TO BRING IN mass vs weight as different operationalizations?

Mass as operationalized on a scale by the force on a spring, or the force produced by a leveraged counterweight on a balance.

Similarly, you may recall that weight ({{< var dim.mass >}} {{< var dim.length >}} {{< var dim.time >}}^-2^) is not the same kind of thing as mass ({{ var dim.mass >}}). The idea of weight goes back to antiquity, but "mass" is much more recent, emerging from Newton's work with gravity in the late 1600s.

:::
